Self-consistency evidence only. What the IDE opens on Review (DiffReview.openChain) is Swing and out of this harness's reach — hand-verified 2026-08-28 in the sandbox. Paths now route through fillPath(), the same helper fixture 40 pins for tool lines, so the Windows step here exercises the SHARED root-strip/backslash handling rather than a second copy. REVIEW-ONLY CLICK 2026-09-01 (user request from a live screenshot): the whole-block action became the .f-review span alone — block cursor auto, span pointer, row/block clicks send nothing. CONTROL RUN against the pre-change build: the row-click assert read [7,7,7] and the cursor assert read 'pointer/pointer'; both FAILED as predicted.
